newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hotel Plaza expects better 1997 results.
newsitem.headline: Hotel Plaza expects better 1997 results.

text.p: Hotel Plaza Ltd said on Friday it expected to post better results in 1997 due to returns from hotels in Australia.
The outlook for hotels in Sydney was positive as the supply of rooms there remained relatively static, the company said in a statement accompanying its results.
It said the opening of new hotels in Perth late last year would bring some competition and reduce rates.
Singapore's hotel industry was expected to stay relatively subdued due to an increase in room supply and the shorter length of stay by visitors.

The company said its 1996 revenue increased mainly due to the inclusion of the full year revenue from the Landmark Parkroyal and Sheraton Perth Hotel, acquired in March 1995 and December 1995 respectively.
The group's investment in Australia also contributed positively to its 1996 operating profit, the statement said.
